_comment: Version + catalog mapping for the BUNDLED wrapper slots (#132). listSlots() reads this (tiny, instant — no tar decompression) so bundled cards show a real version instead of 'Unknown'. catalogId + catalogVersion map a bundled slot to its canonical catalog entry so the manager can flag 'update available' when the catalog ships a newer version. Bump catalogVersion here whenever a bundled wrapper asset is swapped to a newer upstream build.

wrapper-leegao.tzst.notes: leegao's Bionic Vulkan wrapper ICD (GameNative-packaged build).

wrapper-gamenative.tzst.notes: GameNative's wrapper (DX12 + integrated BCn), 32-bit game support; leegao's changes for older devices (#1762).

leegao_bcn.tzst.notes: leegao's BCn transcode layer with the device-hook composition fix.
